abilities.name: Psionic Defenses
abilities.description: The horde focuses its psionic energy onto an eney unit, confusing it. Choose an enemy unit that the Thrikreen can see within 12' and do a casting roll of 2d6: if you roll higher than (12 - the number of tokens in this unit)+, the chosen target gains a -1 on its hit rolls and -1 on its save rolls until the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Psionic Flexibility
abilities.description: The Horde can use its ranged weapons as if they were melee weapons during during the fight phase.
